result.title: Therapeutic effects of traditional Chinese medicine injections with heat-clearing and detoxifying properties on viral pneumonia: a systematic review and network meta-analysis.

evidence.quote: We used the R software (version 4.4.2) for statistical analysis and performed NMA with the BUGSnet, GeMTC, and netmeta packages.
